title: Florida AG, alongside 2 other red states, subpoenas Fauci - NewsBreak
text:
By Arek Sarkissian ,
13 hours ago
TALLAHASSEE, Florida — Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier announced Wednesday that his office, alongside two other red states, issued a subpoena to former Covid czar Anthony Fauci for records tied to grant money, awards and book deals, among other areas of investigation.
A pandemic diary kept by Fauci, a consistent GOP target for his Covid-era decision-making, was released just before a Senate hearing last month in which he declined to answer questions Homeland Security Chair Rand Paul (R-Ky.). Just hours after the hearing, Uthmeier announced a Florida investigation into Fauci .
On Wednesday, Uthmeier’s office sent a news release announcing the attorneys general in Louisiana and West Virginia have since joined Florida’s investigation. Based on Fauci’s diary, his office sent a subpoena asking for records tied to a $900,000 grant given to the University of Florida Scripps Biomedical research program, Uthmeier’s news release said.
The subpoena also requested records related to offers for professorships, book deals, board positions and private foundation partnerships, the release said.
“If Fauci personally profited off of the ‘guidance’ he issued, that very well could have broken Florida law,” Uthmeier said in the release. “Fauci’s diary focused more on self-promotion than the legitimate safety concerns from the mRNA vaccines.”
Two vaccine manufacturers quickly produced Covid vaccines using mRNA technology, which alters cells infected by the virus so they produce the proteins needed to fight it. The shots were rushed to market even though mRNA technology had not been fully tested, and now libertarian-leaning health groups claim the shots led to thousands of deaths and left others irreparably injured.
The push to ban mRNA Covid vaccines was pressed by officials such as Florida Surgeon General Joseph Ladapo, who recommended against taking the shot. Ladapo also personally altered state reports about the vaccines to show they carry a high risk of cardiac death for adult men.
Pfizer and Moderna have also faced scrutiny over the effectiveness of their Covid shots. For instance, Pfizer’s shot was said to provide more than 90 percent efficacy shortly after it was released in December 2020. But later tests showed the efficacy rate for Pfizer’s vaccine was less than half of what the company originally thought.
“While Fauci was pushing for book deals, awards, and fortune and fame, Floridians were being deceived and harmed by his misrepresentations,” Uthmeier said.
